name: No Hesitation
description: You must give your answer within 3 seconds of the answers being revealed.
penalty: Failure to answer in time counts as an incorrect answer.

name: No Rewording
description: You must give your answer exactly as it appears among the answer choices.
penalty: Changing or paraphrasing the answer counts as an incorrect answer.

name: No Questioning
description: You cannot ask the host to clarify, repeat, or explain anything about the question.
penalty: Asking a question immediately ends your turn.

name: No Confirmation
description: You cannot ask another player whether your answer is correct before locking it in.
penalty: Seeking confirmation immediately ends your turn.

name: No I Think
description: You cannot use phrases such as "I think," "probably," "maybe," or other uncertainty phrases before your answer.
penalty: Using an uncertainty phrase counts as a failed answer.

name: No Gestures
description: You cannot use hand gestures, pointing, nodding, or other physical signals while answering.
penalty: Using a gesture immediately ends your turn.

name: Solo Turn
description: Only the affected player may speak while their question is being answered.
penalty: Any teammate who speaks causes the affected turn to end.

name: Dead Serious
description: You cannot laugh, joke, or make intentional comedic remarks while answering your question.
penalty: Breaking the rule immediately ends your turn.

name: Double Check
description: Before giving your final answer, you must repeat the question aloud.
penalty: Failing to repeat the question makes the answer invalid.

name: No Pointing
description: You cannot point at the answer you want to select.
penalty: Pointing immediately ends your turn.

name: One Chance
description: Once you select an answer, you cannot change it.
penalty: Changing your answer counts as incorrect.

name: Name Ban
description: You cannot say another player's name while the curse is active.
penalty: Saying another player's name immediately ends your turn.

name: Question Repeat
description: The question must be repeated by the host before you are allowed to answer.
penalty: Attempting to answer before the repeat makes the answer invalid.

name: No Reaction
description: You cannot verbally react to whether an answer was correct or incorrect.
penalty: A verbal reaction immediately ends your turn.

name: Full Explanation
description: You must explain why your answer is correct before the answer can be accepted.
penalty: Giving only the answer without an explanation counts as incomplete.

name: Quiet Turn
description: You cannot speak except when giving your final answer.
penalty: Any unnecessary speech ends your turn.

name: Open Book
description: Other players may discuss the question openly while you are trying to answer, but you cannot participate in their discussion.
penalty: Joining the discussion ends your turn.

name: Double or Nothing
description: Your next answer has twice the normal reward and twice the normal penalty.
penalty: An incorrect answer loses twice the normal amount.

name: Forbidden Word
description: A random common word is forbidden for the target player while the curse is active.
penalty: Saying the selected forbidden word triggers the curse penalty.

name: Nickname
description: The target player must be addressed by a randomly selected nickname while the curse is active.
penalty: Addressing the target by a different name instead of the selected nickname triggers the curse penalty.
